Regarding the operational processes at AutoBuild, the reliance on a single central repository for tools and materials creates a significant bottleneck. The need for workers to travel long distances across the site to retrieve items results in lost productivity due to excessive commuting time. To improve efficiency, AutoBuild should consider decentralizing the storage of tools and materials by establishing smaller, localized supply points closer to different construction areas. This would reduce travel time, minimize downtime, and enhance overall workflow efficiency.
